new_theses.description: Will the combined data center capital expenditure of the big four AI hyperscalers reach $1 trillion in calendar 2027, the aggregate AI-infrastructure spend Nvidia projects and on which its GPU demand depends?
new_theses.outcome: The big four AI hyperscalers' combined data center capital expenditure for calendar 2027, as disclosed in their full-year results.
new_theses.period: Calendar 2027 (the item's 'next year' from its 2026 date), when the four hyperscalers report full-year capex; set by the item, which projects the figure could reach $1 trillion in 2027 up from around $650 billion in 2026.
new_theses.settled_by: The four leading AI hyperscalers' quarterly and full-year capital expenditure disclosures in their earnings releases and 10-K/10-Q filings for FY2027, aggregated.
new_theses.why_a_separate_bet: clean-3 tracks whether Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform reaches first shipments by end-2026, a product-timing question; this thesis tracks the industry-level capex quantity that drives total GPU demand. They can move independently: Rubin could ship on schedule while hyperscaler capex is cut back, or Rubin could slip while aggregate capex stays high on spending for existing platforms.

new_theses.description: How much will the big four AI hyperscalers spend on data center capital expenditures in calendar 2026, against the around $650 billion they plan?
new_theses.outcome: The big four AI hyperscalers' combined data center capital expenditure for calendar 2026, as disclosed in their full-year results.
new_theses.period: Calendar 2026, settled by the four companies' full-year 2026 results; set by the item's 2026 plan.
new_theses.settled_by: The four leading AI hyperscalers' quarterly and full-year capital expenditure disclosures in their earnings releases and 10-K/10-Q filings for FY2027, aggregated.
new_theses.why_a_separate_bet: This year's spending is checked against a plan and can miss it while next year's projection holds; an analyst bets on each year.

evidence.summary: The article states that the big four AI hyperscalers plan to spend around $650 billion on data center capital expenditures in calendar 2026.
source_passages: The big four AI hyperscalers plan to spend around $650 billion on data center capital expenditures this year.
evidence.original_party: Big four AI hyperscalers (aggregate spending plan)

links.relevance: Provides the 2026 base level of combined hyperscaler data center capex against which the projected 2027 figure is measured; it is the demand backdrop for Nvidia's GPUs, not a statement of Nvidia's own revenue.
States the 2026 plan of about $650 billion, the figure the 2026 thesis is checked against; a plan, not a reported spend.

evidence.summary: Nvidia projects that the big four AI hyperscalers' data center capital expenditures could reach $1 trillion in calendar 2027 (next year), up from the roughly $650 billion planned for 2026.
source_passages: Next year, Nvidia projects that this figure could reach $1 trillion.

links.relevance: Nvidia's own projection of the 2027 combined hyperscaler capex quantity directly addresses the shared-quantity thesis; it is a forecast, not a confirmed figure.
